answer: An agent identity is anchored to an attested enclave key and its MRENCLAVE, so copying a VM image alone cannot forge that hardware-backed identity. MRENCLAVE identifies enclave code and configuration, not a unique chip; Sybil resistance therefore depends on hardware-bound keys and verifier policy, which make scaling identities require additional eligible silicon rather than mere virtual duplication. The trellis of attestations can expose mismatches, while an onyx-like root of trust protects each key.
